description: SAPIENT connector configuration for BMS application
note: Configure connection to SAPIENT Data Fusion Node or run as server for sensor connections

affiliationMap.description: Map sensor classifications to affiliations based on context

notes.protobufSupport: Full protobuf parsing requires building with SAPIENT proto files. Without them, the connector operates in simplified mode with limited message parsing.
notes.messageFormat: SAPIENT messages use a 4-byte network-order length prefix followed by protobuf-encoded SapientMessage (BSI Flex 335 v2.0)
notes.detectionReports: Detection reports are converted to map symbols based on classification type and default affiliation setting
notes.coordinateSystems: Supports LAT_LNG_DEG_M coordinates. Range/bearing coordinates require sensor position for conversion.
